messages:
paula.m: Starting quiet-window deploy: v2026.03.20-rc2 -> canary 5% now. ETA ~10m. Release notes: https://git.redwood/release/2026.03.20-rc2

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-id=cny-20260320-17, target=5%, initiated_by=paula.m

alice: heads-up: are we pinning the model-serving image this run? last rollout had drift. @ben.k please confirm.

ben.k: will pin to sha. pushing image pin now -> registry.redwood/internal/model-serving@sha256:0a3b4f9c... :white_check_mark:

paula.m: pin applied, thanks. Abort criteria we agreed: error-rate >= 1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increase > 300ms vs baseline. SRE, validate thresholds?

sre-jordan: :thumbsup: those look good. I'll add automated triggers: (1) 2% errors for 3m OR (2) canary absolute error spike >1% within 5m. Follow canary-abort flow in runbook: https://runbooks.internal/deploy-backout#canary-abort

paula.m: @deploy-bot, enable metric watch for errors, p50/p95 latency, 5xx, and success_ratio. post to #eng-oncall on trigger.

deploy-bot: monitoring hooks enabled for canary-id=cny-20260320-17. Will post alerts to #eng-oncall and this thread on trigger.

paula.m: quick reminder of abort steps (runbook summary): 1) pause rollout 2) pin traffic back to v2026.03.19 3) open incident using template 'deploy-backout' 4) collect logs + heap profiles and attach to ticket. Everyone aware?

alice: copying the exact pin command from runbook for fast action if needed:
```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/deploys/pin \
  -d '{"service":"model-serving","version":"v2026.03.19"}'
```

paula.m: good. note: DB migrations in this release are non-destructive, no locks expected.

ben.k: canary stats @ 3m: errors 0.08% (baseline 0.05%), p95 +40ms. No abnormal 5xx. continuing.

sre-jordan: if we abort, I'll lead triage and own incident creation. Paula, please assign in PD to me if we hit triggers.

paula.m: assigned to SRE-Jordan in PD.

deploy-bot: canary progress: 40% traffic -> advancing per plan. next milestone: 75% in ~20m.

alice: small flag note: this deploy flips feature-flag 'fast-kv'. If cache miss or kv errors increase, we should flip OFF early. See runbook section 'feature-flag escape'.

paula.m: agree. admin-console -> features -> fast-kv -> OFF is the escape. Ben, you're watching.

ben.k: watching metrics, will flip if any kv errors spike.

paula.m: update: no abort. progressing to 75% then to 100% in remaining window. Will post final release note when complete. Thanks all for quick checks. :rocket:
